title.value: UNSW HDR Scholarships: UNSW 2027 March Release (Term 2, 2027 start)

description_short: UNSW Sydney's 2027 March Release is the Higher Degree Research scholarship round for candidates starting in Term 2, 2027. Applications close on 15 January 2027 at midnight Australian time, with offers expected from 25 March 2027.
